id: title:Gilbert09:free bigquery load buffers after each load job

review.posthog_relevance: BigQuery LoadJob polling reliability and transient error handling
review.reason: Adds transient error classification and retry configuration for BigQuery LoadJob polling, distinguishing recoverable exceptions from permanent failures. This supports warehouse ingestion reliability without requiring complete implementation or test results.
review.uncertainty: Chunk does not include complete implementation, removal of blocking behavior, or complete test; tier assigned based on observable exception handling and retry configuration, not full behavioral change.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the new async polling and the complete removal of the blocking behavior, nor does it include the complete removal of the blocking behavior. The chunk also does not include the complete implementation of the new async polling and the complete removal of the blocking behavior. The chunk also does not include the complete test

observations.behavior: Adds BadGateway and RetryError to the list of exceptions imported from google.api_core.exceptions.
observations.posthog_connection: These exceptions are used later in the polling retry loop to distinguish transient errors that warrant retrying the load job polling, rather than immediately failing or uploading the file again.

observations.behavior: Adds RetryError to the list of exceptions imported from google.api_core.exceptions.
observations.posthog_connection: RetryError is added to the set of exceptions that indicate transient failures during the polling of a BigQuery LoadJob, allowing the system to retry the polling rather than immediately failing.

observations.behavior: Defines LOAD_JOB_POLL_RETRYABLE_EXCEPTIONS, a tuple of exceptions that indicate transient failures during the polling of a BigQuery LoadJob.
observations.posthog_connection: This tuple is used to catch transient errors during the polling of a BigQuery LoadJob, allowing the system to retry the polling rather than immediately failing. This helps prevent unnecessary re-uploads of the file.
